sources.title: Atelier Moessmer Norbert Niederkofler — OAD Guides
sources.claim: Atelier Moessmer Norbert Niederkofler is at Via Walther von der Vogelweide 17, 39031 Brunico (BZ), Italy.

sources.title: Brunico → Brixen distance
sources.claim: Brixen/Bressanone sits 23.63 km air-line from Brunico — inside a 30 km radius, but ~35 km by road.

sources.title: Cognitive Science Arena 2026 — ESCoP
sources.claim: Cognitive Science Arena (CSA) 14th edition runs February 5–7, 2026 in Bressanone (Brixen), Italy for early-career cognitive-science researchers.

sources.title: DSTNCMP 2026 — Brixen
sources.claim: DSTNCMP (DestinationCamp) 2026 takes place May 5–7, 2026 in Brixen, South Tyrol.

sources.title: DSTNCMP — about
sources.claim: DSTNCMP draws 200+ participants from tourism, academia, hospitality, agencies, technology and platforms.

sources.title: CSAMA 2026 — Bioconductor
sources.claim: CSAMA 2026 Biological Data Science Summer School runs May 24–29, 2026 in Bressanone (Casa della Gioventù).

sources.title: CSAMA 2026 — Bioinformatics.it
sources.claim: CSAMA is the 22nd edition, held at the University of Padova site (Casa della Gioventù) in Bressanone.

sources.title: SPE 13 / OntoBRIX 2026
sources.claim: SPE 13 / OntoBRIX 2026 is held June 8–10, 2026 at PTH Brixen College, Bressanone — fee €50.

sources.title: CMT@Brixen 2026
sources.claim: CMT@Brixen 2026 — Condensed Matter Theory conference, 3rd edition — runs 26–28 August 2026 in Brixen.

sources.title: NOI Techpark Brunico
sources.claim: NOI Techpark Brunico is a 4,000 m² Centre for Sustainable Mobility with 5 seminar rooms (up to 450 combined).

sources.title: NOI Techpark Bruneck — unibz
sources.claim: NOI Techpark Bruneck entrance is at Europastraße 9, 39031 Bruneck.

sources.title: IN MOTION Tech Festival — AES
sources.claim: An IN MOTION Tech Festival 2026 edition is announced — only a 'NEXT EDITION 2026' placeholder so far.

sources.title: IN MOTION Tech Festival 2025 — alto adige innovazione
sources.claim: IN MOTION Tech Festival 2025 (3rd ed.) ran 10 May 2025 at NOI Techpark Brunico.

sources.title: Automotive Transformation Conference — NOI Brunico
sources.claim: Automotive Transformation Conference ran 23–24 October 2025 at NOI Techpark Brunico.

sources.title: TTTech Innovation Campus Brixen
sources.claim: TTTech Innovation Campus Brixen is scheduled to open by 2026 with an AI lab and machine-vision focus.

sources.title: Tech Talks South Tyrol — Meetup
sources.claim: Tech Talks South Tyrol is a 532-member developer meetup alternating Brixen and Bolzano venues.

sources.title: Tech Talks South Tyrol — Duka, Brixen (Nov 2024)
sources.claim: A November 2024 Tech Talks South Tyrol Meetup was hosted at Duka in Brixen.

sources.title: NOBIS Brunico
sources.claim: NOBIS is the event centre directly adjacent to NOI Techpark Brunico, at Via Europa 9.

sources.title: FORUM Brixen — Cultural and Congress Centre
sources.claim: FORUM Brixen is a Bressanone congress venue with 6 meeting rooms (48–555 people, 622 m² main hall).

sources.title: Cusanus Akademie — Brixen
sources.claim: Cusanus Akademie (Piazza Seminario 2, Brixen) is the diocesan congress centre, 10 rooms, capacity 10–700.

sources.title: SFSCON 2026 — Bolzano
sources.claim: SFSCON 2026 runs 13–14 November 2026 at NOI Techpark, Bolzano, ~75 km from Brunico.

sources.title: CSAMA 2026 — Huber group / EMBL
sources.claim: CSAMA 2026 covers single-cell & spatial omics with R/Bioconductor, 11 instructors.
